goal: Deliver Phase 2 frontend lane: reflection evidence curation and 3-tier weekly replay UX under streamlit-safe non-blocking constraints.

constraints.notes: Maintain streamlit rerun stability. Keep 3D strictly read-only replay with single CTA and Skip.

acceptance: Reflection shows evidence curation (1~2 items) with meaning or skip action.
7-day replay with 3-tier hierarchy (session_completed/session_interrupted/supporting_evidence) is consistently rendered.
Plan-first/Focus-first/Journal paths remain demoable without core-loop blocking regressions.
Schema-valid result/handoff with reproducible demo runbook evidence is published.

risk.note: Excessive rerun-triggering state mutations can degrade responsiveness and break demo continuity.

next_actions: Implement evidence curation interaction with minimal state churn.
Implement constrained 7-day 3-tier replay and CTA+Skip behavior.
Publish schema-valid frontend phase2 result/handoff artifacts with runbook evidence.
